artist_notes.name: Casmalia
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ, producer, and live vocalist — classically trained with a degree in audio engineering; releases on Insomniac, mau5trap, Night Bass and CUFF. Her 'Unicorns Only' series is exactly what she's running here: house, tech-house and techno from the rare/underground end. 'Don't Tell Me How To Rave' hit #1 trending on SoundCloud US in 2025.

enrichment.curator_note: Casmalia's 'Unicorns Only' takeover of the Sunset Sessions rooftop is a good pairing — she's a West Coast house figure with real production chops, not just a selector, and the Level 8 setting (free, 5–10pm, golden hour over DTLA) is the exact format that keeps working. Worth going even if the name isn't immediately familiar.
enrichment.description: Sunset Sessions presents Casmalia's 'Unicorns Only' takeover at Level 8 DTLA rooftop, 5–10pm; free.

artist_notes.name: JKriv
artist_notes.note: JKriv (Josh Krivit) — NYC house/disco DJ and Razor-N-Tape label co-founder; known for deep crate-digging, soul-inflected edits and long late-night sets. Bar Franca in Silver Lake is exactly the right room for this.

enrichment.curator_note: JKriv at Bar Franca is a walkable Silver Lake score — Razor-N-Tape's house/disco sound fits the venue perfectly, and it's free. The Midnight Lovers format at smaller Silver Lake spots is among the week's best casual picks if you're eastside.
enrichment.description: Midnight Lovers with JKriv (Razor-N-Tape) at Bar Franca in Silver Lake, 6/26 (afterhours); free.

events.title: Sorry For Party Rocking (2010-2015 Pop & Edm All Night Long!)

enrichment.curator_note: A 2010–2015 pop-and-EDM nostalgia night at Catch One — 'Sorry For Party Rocking' is the title, and that tells you exactly what you're getting. Not remotely the lane, but there's something kind of charming about committing this hard to the LMFAO era. Easy skip.
enrichment.description: 2010–2015 pop and EDM nostalgia party at Catch One in Mid-City, 9pm–2am; free with RSVP before 10:30pm.

enrichment.curator_note: LA DISCOTECA at The Slipper Clutch — a recurring DTLA latin disco and house night in a compact venue. Free entry, afterhours, good for a late-night stop if you're already downtown.
enrichment.description: LA DISCOTECA at The Slipper Clutch in DTLA, 6/26 (afterhours); free.

artist_notes.name: Yaeji
artist_notes.note: Kathy Yaeji Lee — NY/Korean DJ/producer (XL/Ninja Tune) whose sound sits between lo-fi house, leftfield electronics and indie-pop; her 2023 album 'With a Hammer' crossed over while keeping its underground roots. One of the week's top bookings.

artist_notes.name: Alima Lee
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ and co-founder of the FREQ collective — deep, dancefloor-focused selections from the LA underground.

artist_notes.name: Hu Dat
artist_notes.note: LA DJ, Lights Down Low regular — deep house and club-leaning selections.

enrichment.curator_note: Yaeji's crossover between house-pop and leftfield club is a rare combination — she's one of the only artists who can genuinely hold a late-night DTLA warehouse *and* pull listeners from outside the scene. Lights Down Low keeps the format right: TBA venue, afterhours, proper sound. Week's top booking.
enrichment.description: Lights Down Low presents Yaeji at a TBA Downtown LA location, 6/26 (afterhours); $22–46.

events.title: Day Trip Festival SoCal Preparty with Green Velvet and Ugo Banchi

artist_notes.name: Green Velvet
artist_notes.note: Curtis Jones — Chicago techno/house legend (Relief Records, Cajmere persona); acid-house and rave-era energy with modern DJ precision. Genuinely important figure.

artist_notes.name: Ugo Banchi
artist_notes.note: Italian-born DJ, tech-house circuit; modern European-influenced selections.

enrichment.curator_note: Day Trip's SoCal preparty at Exchange LA the night before the Long Beach festival — Green Velvet is a genuine Chicago techno legend, and Exchange has proper infrastructure. $45-95 is steep for a prep party but earns it with the headliner. If you're going to Day Trip on 6/28, this is a worthy pre-game.
enrichment.description: Day Trip Festival SoCal Preparty with Green Velvet and Ugo Banchi at Exchange LA in DTLA, 6/26 (afterhours); $45–95.

events.title: BAILE WORLD Pride ft Bambii, Jubilee, Introspekt, & More

artist_notes.name: Bambii
artist_notes.note: Jamaican-Canadian DJ/producer (Kirsten Azan), Toronto — runs the JERK club night celebrating the Caribbean diaspora; Juno Award winner (Electronic Album of the Year 2024). Lush, exuberant club music that bridges Caribbean sound and experimental electronic.

artist_notes.name: Jubilee
artist_notes.note: NYC producer/DJ (Mixpak), Miami roots — high-energy sets spanning grime, dancehall, techno and R&B; one of the more interesting cross-genre selectors in the queer/club world.

artist_notes.name: Introspekt
artist_notes.note: Leimert Park-born, now NY-based DJ/producer — releases on Locked On, T4T LUV NRG, EC2A; bass-heavy club music rooted in UK garage and dubstep, NTS resident. Mixmag 2023 breakthrough DJ.

enrichment.curator_note: Baile World is pulling a genuinely impressive Pride lineup here — Bambii and Jubilee together is a proper double bill, and Introspekt adds the underground credibility. This is the kind of queer club night where the music is the whole point, not just the backdrop. 188 attending on RA already means the room will have energy.
enrichment.description: Baile World Pride afterhours at a TBA DTLA location (11pm–5am) with Bambii, Jubilee, Introspekt, Spiñorita and Cquestt; $11–33.

# Taste profile — EXAMPLE friend profile for the dashboard profile-switcher (username: demo).
# Deliberately different from the root taste.yaml so switching visibly re-ranks: this person is
# an indie/rock + jazz + comedy head who's lukewarm on big-room electronic. Copy this file to
# profiles/<name>/taste.yaml, edit it, add an entry to profiles.yaml, then run build_profiles.py.

categories:
  high:    # +3
    - indie / rock / post-punk / garage / dream-pop / experimental band shows
      (Troubadour, Echo, Zebulon, Lodge Room, Teragram, Moroccan)
    - jazz, soul, funk, and live-band nights (listening rooms, small clubs)
    - rep & arthouse cinema (Vidiots, Vista, New Beverly, Cinematheque, Brain Dead)
    - singer-songwriter / folk / Americana in intimate rooms
  medium:  # +2
    - standup comedy at clubs and theaters (a genuine draw here, not the exception)
    - theater (black-box + Pantages-scale)
    - daytime & lifestyle — flea / vintage / design markets, farmers markets, food pop-ups
    - melodic / organic / disco-leaning house in a chill setting (not the main thing)
  low:     # +1, only if exceptional
    - big-room / festival EDM and warehouse techno — occasional, only marquee names

boosts:    # +1 each
  - intimate / seated / listening-room setting
  - walkable or short drive from Santa Monica / the Westside
  - Friday or Saturday night
  - independent editorial mention (LAist, Time Out, DiscoverLA)
  - vinyl / all-analog presentation

penalties: # -2 each
  - big-room / festival-scale EDM as the main draw
  - warehouse / afterhours raves
  - bottle-service / table-service clubs
  - hardstyle / dubstep / bass-music mega-shows
  - far-flung (OC / SD / Temecula / Ventura) unless genuinely worth the trip
